# IdeDockCaptionMode

`Flare.Components.IDE.IdeDockCaptionMode`

How FlareIdeLayout draws the caption of a side dock strip - the control above the left or right tool region that returns to the tools while a docked document covers them. The Center strip is configured separately with ShowCenterDockStrip and CenterDockHeader.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Text` | `0` | The caption is the button's visible text. This is the default. |
| `IconOnly` | `1` | The button shows only an icon; the localized region name stays its accessible name. |
| `Hidden` | `2` | The caption is not painted. The return-to-tools button keeps its localized accessible name and stays available to assistive technology while a docked document covers the region, and a side region without documents draws no strip at all, so no empty row is painted. |

## Used by components

- `FlareIdeLayout`
